description: Bounded public disposition for the Alice campaign's model identity, mixed-quantization artifact composition, host/device expert residency split, and the explicit host expert arena: cold-mmap 4.49 t/s, 8 GiB arena 13.99, 12 GiB shipped 14.93, 12 GiB pinned 15.58; 95.308% hit, destructive parity max|diff| = 0.0. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_name: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base (custom alice_ai hybrid KDA linear-attention + MoE)
model_revision: source checkpoint; the quantized container is excluded from publication
model_download_source: public base checkpoint exists; no weight payload or container byte is part of this repository
quant_name: Q3.9-MIX (52 x Q4_K + 44 x Q3_K expert tensors, trunk q8_0, control f32)

gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; 32 GiB host RAM; NVMe; llama.cpp-derived research runtime
prompt: campaign workload prompts are excluded; no prompt is reproduced here
context_size: 262144 supported; arena frontier measured at the deployed short-context configuration
warmup: campaign warm-up prefill plus arena pre-seed; frontier rows are post-warm

tolerance.decode_tps: configuration-dependent; the frontier is a ladder, not a tolerance band
tolerance.hit_rate: reported to the receipt's precision; the 99.536% figure is invalid, not a tolerance issue

known_limitations: The artifact, weights, and container bytes are excluded, so this lane is not a runnable public benchmark.
The parameter count has an unreconciled second reading of 81.29 B in a server load log.
The arena hit rate is a property of one workload trace and one deployed configuration.
The 99.536% hit-rate figure was invalidated by a per-layer unit-size bug and is retained only as a correction record.
